note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SL 8(2), 8(3), Schedule 3; A06b SL 8(2), 8(3), Schedule 3; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 15 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: No provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Group restriction: only if citizen parent is member of a particular group, race or religion), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states (the dataset codes no separate descent rule for a child born in the country, birth there giving it; the parent's sex is read from mode A01b). The coding also records a restriction to members of a particular group, which the form holds only in the condition's words, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Sierra Leone, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Sierra Leone for at least 15 years. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... No provision ... Group restriction: only if citizen parent is member of a particular group, race or religion ... Person is born abroad to a parent who is a citizen and is of negro African descent. ... No provision ... Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion ... Person is born in Sierra Leone and one parent or any grandparent was also born there and is of negro African descent.

atBirth.soilIf: Person is born in Sierra Leone and one parent or any grandparent was also born there and is of negro African descent.
atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a parent who is a citizen and is of negro African descent.
